library(tidyverse)
library(KFAS)


macro_df$Date <- as.Date(macro_df$Date)


library(KFAS)
ggplot(macro_df, aes(x = Date, y = Interest_Rate)) +
  geom_line(color = "darkred", linewidth = 1) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "India Interest Rate (2004 - 2026)",
       x = "Year",
       y = "Interest Rate (%)")


ggplot(macro_df, aes(x = CPI, y = Interest_Rate)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, color = "blue") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "darkorange", se = FALSE) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "CPI vs. Interest Rate",
       x = "Consumer Price Index",
       y = "Interest Rate (%)")



model <- SSModel(Real_GDP ~ SSMtrend(degree = 1, Q = NA) + CPI + Interest_Rate, 
                 data = macro_df, 
                 H = NA)


fit <- fitSSM(model, inits = c(0, 0), method = "BFGS")


out <- KFS(fit$model)


summary(out)


macro_df$Smoothed_GDP <- out$muhat[,1] 

ggplot(macro_df, aes(x = Date)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Real_GDP, color = "Actual GDP"), alpha = 0.5, linewidth = 1) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Smoothed_GDP, color = "Smoothed Trend (KFAS)"), linewidth = 1, linetype="dashed") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Actual India GDP vs. KFAS Smoothed Trend (2004-2026)",
       y = "Real GDP",
       x = "Date",
       color = "Legend")
